note: Who stands where, by scene and era. Characters are placed only where their story puts them. Walking up to one and pressing X (Square) unlocks them and switches to them, exactly as in the marsh village; the unlocked collection is saved and shared by every scene, and Tab / D-pad left cycles through it. An unlocked character who is not in the current scene joins the player's side when cycled to. 'chamber' places someone in a named room of a cave site; otherwise they wait with the group near the arrival point. Era variants swap the model they have in that era.
